    Class
    Description
    AModuleController
    Optional shared base for module mini-controllers, mirroring ballworld.controller.ABaseController: gives every module controller a shared system logger for free (via ILoggerControl.getSharedLogger(), the same singleton BallWorld's own WebSocketManager/MessageRouter already use) instead of each module wiring its own.
